  The dev server holds port 8787 even after the tab closes. Two ways to clear it:

  lsof -tiTCP:8787 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill

  Or force it if it will not die:

  lsof -tiTCP:8787 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9

  Background jobs started from chat die the same way: close that terminal tab, or
  use the lsof command above.

  Do you want me to add a predev script that frees the port automatically?
